clauses.quote: Participating Teacher may discontinue his or her participation in this program at any time.
A Volunteer Participating Teacher's participation shall not continue for more than one school year or the balance thereof.
clauses.notes: Extracted as second independent clause after splitting on 'and'; first clause was descriptive.

clauses.quote: The Consulting Teacher shall not participate in the evaluation of the Volunteer Participating Teacher.

The Panel shall review Volunteer Participating Teacher applications to approve participating in the Program or refer them to the District for consideration to participate in another District-approved program.
A Referred Participating Teacher may prioritize up to three Consulting Teacher choices from a panel of available Consulting Teachers.
The Panel shall assign a Consulting Teacher from this list in the order of the Referred Participating Teacher preference as the Consulting Teacher selections are available.
The Referred Participating Teacher may appeal to the Panel for a different Consulting Teacher.
The Referred Participating Teacher has the right to be represented at all formal conferences and meetings.
All Participating Teachers shall receive up to $250 reimbursement for instructional supplies and materials for participation in the Program with the concurrence of the Consulting Teacher.
